partial_correlation_note: Control = OpenCompass OpenVLM MMMU_VAL (primary) and MMBench_TEST_EN_V11 (secondary), same VLMEvalKit evaluator and same model snapshots as the spatial board. Gemini 2.5 Flash and o4-mini have no OpenVLM entry, so they drop out of partial correlations. Partial r is the correlation of OLS residuals after regressing both variables on the control; p from t with df=n-3. Partial Spearman = same on ranks.
